conviction_note: H1 profit was pre-released on 2026-09-14 (OP 1,054m, +20% vs plan) and the interim dividend raised then, so the print turns almost entirely on whether the full-year plan (OP 2,160m, which implies H2 OP down ~5% YoY against an H1 up 28.5%) is raised today; the company explicitly deferred that decision 'until the spillover is clear' and last year held the FY plan at H1 and only revised in March, so I put an FY upgrade at roughly 30% — a positive skew in the findings (+0.5) but only a slight lean in p_up (53) on a ~4% scale, with the 中計's flagged equity raise and a 60% run since July with 信用倍率 5.0 as the offsets.
bar: H1 consolidated OP 1,054m / ordinary 1,051m / sales 2,960m from the company's own 2026-09-14 revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260914/140120260910533968.pdf); full-year plan OP 2,160m / ordinary 2,160m / NP 1,440m held unchanged (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260721/140120260717595695.pdf). No 四季報/IFIS number could be sourced, so the FY bar the market holds is unsourced and the guidance finding is capped.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-20: no disclosed position >=0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0) per baseline (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 5.03 (kabutan 2026-10-21 page, matches baseline) = margin longs crowded, which is the setup where a hold-the-plan disappointment still has sellers. No options, no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.162 (margin overhang -0.35, run-up +0.19). Stock 751 -> 1,191 since 2026-07-17 (+59%) on Q1 (+20% on 7/21) and the 中計 (limit-up 8/21).

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 2,160m) was left unchanged when H1 OP was raised 20% to 1,054m on 9/14, so the plan now implies H2 OP of ~1,106m vs 1,168m last year (-5% YoY) after H1 +28.5%; on this company's own H1 share of full-year OP (43.6% FY3/25, 41.2% FY3/26) the year runs to ~2,400-2,560m, and the company twice wrote it will give the full-year number 'when the spillover is clear' — an FY upgrade (with a payout-linked year-end dividend raise, policy 81-90% payout) is a live possibility at this release, though last year it held the plan at H1 and revised only on 2026-03-18.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-21 Q1 beat with a 'progress ahead of plan' notice: +20% day (Yahoo tape 751->901). 2026-09-14 H1 upgrade +20% with FY held: close +1.9% (1,161->1,183). 2026-04-22 FY guide of OP +8.7%: baseline -7.29%. 2025-10-22 H1 with FY held and dividend raised: baseline +2.45%. Upgrades are bought; holds are small.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the FY plan is raised today is undecided and binary; the stock trades at ~31x the unrevised plan EPS of 38.50, which prices some upgrade but not a specific number, and last year's identical setup ended in a hold, so the market cannot treat an upgrade as done. If an upgrade were fully priced the stock would have run into the print rather than sit at 1,191 vs 1,245 on 9/17.
findings.independence: Same company's 2026-07-21 Q1 progress notice uses the identical deferral language (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260721/140120260716595158.pdf); the 2026-03-18 FY revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260318/140120260318584117.pdf) and the FY3/26 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260422/140120260421507581.pdf) give the H1-share history. All are company documents.

findings.finding: Implied Q2 (Jul-Sep) growth decelerated sharply: from the 9/14 revised H1 less Q1 actuals, Q2 sales ~1,437m (+6% YoY vs 1,356m) and OP ~503m (+10% vs 456m), against Q1's +17.3% sales and +51% OP, which weakens the 'effect spills through the year' case for an FY upgrade today.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a visible quarterly deceleration at this name in the record; the baseline's only negative reaction (-7.29%, 2026-04-22) came on a conservative new-year guide, not a quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: anyone can compute it from two public documents. Kept small because the 短信 will put the Q2 standalone numbers in front of holders who read the 9/14 headline (+20%) rather than the quarter split.
findings.independence: Computed from the 9/14 revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260914/140120260910533968.pdf) and last year's H1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251022/140120251021576524.pdf); same issuer's documents, one arithmetic fact.

findings.finding: The 2026-08-21 中期経営計画 states the company 'will carry out a capital increase' to fund M&A and to improve liquidity toward a Prime move; an offering announced alongside or right after the H1 results would land in the window as a negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior offering since listing; the company bought back stock via ToSTNeT-3 in July 2025. No reaction history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The intent is public but undated; the stock rose 16% on the day the plan was published, so holders read the plan as growth, not dilution. Sized as a small probability (~5-8%) of a ~5% offering-day drop. What the money buys: M&A per the plan, which the market may also read positively, hence the small size.

outside_window.finding: If the FY plan is held today, the same arithmetic (H2 implied -5% YoY) points to a later FY upgrade, as happened on 2026-03-18 last year (+21.9% OP).

rejected_candidates.detail: Pre-released on 9/14; the only open dividend item (a year-end raise) is merged into the FY-upgrade guidance finding because it is payout-linked to the same decision.

rejected_candidates.detail: Already in the baseline's priced_lean (margin_overhang -0.35); used in p_up rather than filed as a separate finding.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive (+0.5) against a slightly negative priced lean (-0.16, crowded margin longs) and a weak 20-day run-up (-3.8%) after a +59% run since July; the strongest positive the release could carry is an FY upgrade with a year-end dividend raise, which I looked for and could not establish beyond a ~30% chance, so p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on a series the market already has): the Q2-deceleration finding is computable from the 9/14 notice and the Q1 短信, so it was shrunk from -0.4 to -0.2; p_up already near 50.
Rule 2 (check the sign): two of three findings are negative; the strongest positive (FY upgrade + year-end dividend) was searched for and is the largest finding; no further change.
Open question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 kills the event): consistent with keeping abs_move_pct at 4.0 rather than the 7.29 proxy; it is not a rule, so nothing further moved.
